## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 23 ago 2026 - 23 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Tony David_, 23 ago 2026, 1/5: "the app talks to my Samsung watch. but the watch won't send data to the app. the watch will say cannot open health. paid good money for stuff that doesn't work anymore"

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      5 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 jul 2026 - 24 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _George Ristic_, 24 ago 2026, 1/5: "Latest update turned the app into unusable UI mess. I uninstalled the app and decided never to buy Galaxy watch or phone ever again. Switching to Garmin for proper fitness tracking rather than having the "fitness" hardware and software developed by the team of overweight people who never ran more than 100m in their life. Goodbye Samsung, you deserve to be devoured by Chinese phone manufacturers."
            2. _JWM B_, 24 jul 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
            3. _Holly_, 24 ago 2026, 2/5: "Keeps telling me my data hasn't synced in 3 days, then doesn't load the "Sync with Samsung Cloud" option so I can't see what the issue is or do anything to fix it. Seems like a bug. Also feels like it's trying to push some new feature on me everytime I go into the app. All I want is steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts, but there's always some random pop up which you can't just x out of."
<!--/ir-theme-->
